outline: Through class discussion and group presentations, this course will help develop students’ English conversation skills.  In the course of practicing such skills, we will take as our general topic the issue of art and creativity.   Our topics will include:  favorite artists; game play instructions; storytelling and personal creativity; self-portraiture and self-discovery.
